shellCommands.command: git status --short; git branch -a; cat package.json; ls; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print | head -100

git diff; git log --oneline | head; for f in app/*.tsx app/*/*.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version"

ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "cacheComponents\|dynamicIO" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; grep -n "hours" -A6 node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head -20

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rn "force-dynamic\|export const revalidate\|unstable_instant\|export const instant" 01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls 01-app/02-guides | grep -i cache
grep -rn "instant\|export const dynamic\|export const revalidate\|dynamicIO" app next.config.ts; git status --short
